chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad and Aḥmad, the two sons of al-Ḥasan, from their father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
When the blood stops and she has not performed ghusl, then her husband may come to her if he wishes.

key_terms.فَلْيَأْتِهَا: then let him come to her; i.e., have marital relations with her

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a husband to have intercourse with his wife after her menstrual bleeding stops but before she performs ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning intercourse after the cessation of menstrual blood and before ghusl. It indicates that once the blood has stopped, the husband may have relations with his wife, even if she has not yet performed ghusl.
